gloss_en: the radiance/shining of the skin of the face (keirun or ha-panim, from Exodus 34:29 'karan or panav' — the beams of light on Moses's face after Sinai), which Likutey Moharan 38 identifies with the aspect of tefillin and with holy shame (busha); not to be confused with קֶרֶן meaning animal horn or corner
